_meta.description: Cat questions sourced from public HuggingFace dataset playcat/playcat-cat-behavior-new-data-set (community Q&A: r/CatAdvice, r/AskVet, r/cats, r/CATHELP, stackexchange_pets). English originals hand-curated for quality, translated to natural Vietnamese. emer=true marks genuine vet-urgent cases.
